title: Advertising and Affiliate Disclosure - OpenBitcoin
metaDescription: How OpenBitcoin.com is supported: advertising, affiliate links, and sponsorship. How paid placements are labeled and how third-party ad content is handled.
lede: OpenBitcoin.com is supported by advertising, affiliate links, and sponsorship. This page explains how those placements work and how they are identified on the site.

sections.heading: How the site is supported
sections.html:
OpenBitcoin.com is independently operated. It does not charge for access, require user accounts, or sell subscriptions. Operating costs are covered by advertising, affiliate links, and sponsorship.

Paid placements do not affect the data the site displays. Block, transaction, and address data comes from our own Bitcoin full node, and the displayed price of bitcoin is a median of three exchanges.

sections.heading: Affiliate links
sections.html:
Some links on this site are affiliate links. If you use one of these links to sign up for or purchase a product or service, we may earn a commission. This does not typically change the price you pay.

Affiliate placements are labeled where they appear. Our policy is to label every paid placement; anything not labeled as paid is intended to be unpaid.

sections.heading: Advertising and sponsorship
sections.html:
The site may display advertising from third-party ad networks, which may include mainstream or cryptocurrency-focused networks. Ad content is selected and served by those networks, not by us, and its appearance on the site is not an endorsement of the products or services advertised.

Sponsored placements are labeled as such. Sponsorship inquiries can be made through the contact page.

Promotional content may be unavailable in some regions.

sections.heading: Third-party risk reports
sections.html: When live, address pages may link out to third-party risk-report and compliance-scoring services. The scores, labels, and verdicts those services publish are their own, not ours, and we do not produce or edit them. Third-party risk scores can be wrong and have been revised, so treat them as one input rather than a conclusion.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.html: Questions about this disclosure, or about whether a specific placement is paid, can be sent to inbox@openbitcoin.com.
